messages.subject: observe & observeEvent
parts:
Hi,

I had a quick look to the source code of observeEvent. If I interpret it right: basically observeEvent is the same as observe. Thus, instead of

obsA <- observe ({
  do something with input$x
})

I could use

obsA <- observeEvent (input$x, { do something with input$x })

Thanks in advance

Sigbert

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: observe & observeEvent
parts: If the code only has one reactive variable, then yes they're pretty similar with a few small differences (for example, observeEvent by default will ignore NULL values which can come in quite handy).  If you have multiple reactive values in the expression inside `observe()`, then you won't be able to easily achieve a similar behaviour with `observeEvent()` because you have to tell it what single reactive value to listen to
